page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew, Syriac and Latin dictionary entries; no margin notes. Running head at top with page number at top left.

main_text.p: שְׂמֹאל שְׂמָאלָא, שְׂמָאל Ch. Sinistra manus, Sinistrum latus vel pars. Fœm. שְׂמָאלִיתָא, Deut. 11.18. in Jon.
שמם Ethpahel Ch. אשתומם Stupuit, obstupuit, Dan. 4.16. Ithpehal אשתמם Idem: Item Infanum, stupidum, stultum egit, 1. Sam. 21.14. Item Vastari, desolari, Thren. 4.5.
אשתממו Ch. Stupor, terror, desolatio, Jer. 8.21. & 25.19.
שממיתא Ch. Stellio, species avis immundæ, Hebr. הלמאורה Levit. 11.30. in Jonath.
שמן Hebr. Saginari, pinguem esse vel fieri, impinguari: Syr. ܫܡܺܝܢ Cùm pinguis est fructus, id est, Maturuit, Mar. 4.29.
שמנא שמן Ch. Pinguedo, adeps, oleum, butyrum: Item adjectivè, Pinguis.
שומנא Ch. Idè, Jud. 3.22. Syr. ܫܡܢܐ, ad Rom. 11.17.
שמינא Ch. Pinguis, Jesa. 5.1. Pl. שמינין, שמינא, 1. Sam. 15.9.
שומנוניתא, שמנוניתא Chal. Pinguedo, optimum, præstantissimum, Gen. 45.18. Levit. 7.20. in T. Jon.
Syr. Schamuna, quadrans, octava pars oboli, Luc. 12.59. Plur. Marc. 12.49. Vide Notas Tremellii & Junii.

שמע Ch. & Syr. Audivit, inaudivit, exaudivit, attédit, auscultavit. Ihtpeh. אשתמע, Ithpah. אשתמע Audiri, exaudiri: Auscultare, obedire, obtemperare, obedientiæ alicujus se dedere. Aphel אשמע Audire, vel audiri, exaudiri fecit, audiendum proposuit, nunciavit; annunciavit, promulgavit, sonum edidit, sonuit, personuit, resonuit.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek-style vocalised forms are reproduced approximately; Syriac words in the scan are only partly legible and may differ in points and letters.
